---
title: "Primary School Survey 2026"
description: "What parents, school staff and boards of management told the Department of Education about primary school ethos."
---

Part of [Religion in Ireland](index.qmd). See also [Schools](schools.qmd) for who runs Ireland's primary schools today.

Over 90% of Irish primary schools are denominational, yet recent survey data (June 2026) shows substantial and widespread parental demand for multi-denominational education. The charts and maps below explore that gap, school by school and county by county, with a particular focus on how the preferences of parents differ from those of school staff and boards of management.

The data comes from the Department of Education and Youth's [2025–2026 Primary School Survey](https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-education/campaigns/primary-school-survey/) and its [results summary report](https://assets.gov.ie/static/documents/1e08f77c/Primary_School_Survey_Results_Summary_Report_final__.pdf). The results for staff and boards of management are not in the spreadsheet the Department publishes, only in the summary report. The code is [on GitHub](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/tree/main/analysis). The figures are interactive.

## The first survey of its kind

The Department described the survey as "the largest of its kind ever undertaken in Ireland" (press release, 4 November 2025).

::: {.ethos-cards}
::: {.ethos-card}
### What the Department set out to do

"Assess parental demand for different types of primary school provision": ethos, co-education or single-sex, and English- or Irish-medium.
:::

::: {.ethos-card}
### Who was asked

- Parents of children **in** primary school, and of children **not yet enrolled**
- One response per household, validated by Eircode
- Separately, school staff and boards of management
:::
:::

::: {.timeline}
::: {.timeline-step}
**4 Nov 2025**

Survey opens online
:::
::: {.timeline-step}
**16 Dec 2025**

Survey closes: 200,381 valid parent and 32,901 staff and board responses
:::
::: {.timeline-step}
**7 Apr 2026**

National parent results published
:::
::: {.timeline-step}

Each school receives its own report. The summary report adds county results for parents and for staff and boards
:::
::: {.timeline-step .is-next}
**Oct–Nov 2026**

Boards decide whether to act on their results
:::
:::

Staff and board results are published nationally and by county, but not school by school, for privacy reasons.

## How the staff and board of management survey was run

The school staff and board of management survey was open to primary school staff and members of boards of management nationally. The target population was 84,285 staff and board members. A total of 32,999 responses were submitted, and 32,901 valid responses were kept after validation. That is a validated response rate of 39.0% of the eligible population. (Source: results summary report, section 4.1, p. 25.)
:::

## There is a mismatch between the schools parents want for their children and the schools available to them

<iframe src="../figures/vis2_intend_vs_preference.html" width="100%" height="420" style="border:0" title="Chart: ethos preference among households with a child not yet in school, by intended school type" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Figure 5.** Stated ethos preference among households with a child not yet in school (n = 56,227), grouped by the type of school they intend to use. Each bar is 100% of the households intending that school type, split by whether they prefer a multi-denominational (green) or denominational (grey) ethos. This isolates demand for change: households intending a denominational school but preferring a multi-denominational one represent unmet demand, while households intending and preferring the same type represent confirmed preference. Percentages are recomputed from raw counts reported in the source, and the base (56,227) can't be independently checked against the published survey spreadsheet. Source: Department of Education and Youth, Primary School Survey results summary report (June 2026), section 3.1.2, p. 14. Code: [`make_charts.py`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/blob/main/analysis/charts/make_charts.py).
